{{SameName|Vampire|[[Vampire (Nightmare Carnival)|Nightmare Carnival]] • [[Vampire (Trick or Threat Town)|Trick or Threat Town]] • [[Vampire (Solar Eclipse)|Solar Eclipse]]}}{{EventEnded|date=26th of January 2022|event=[[Solar Eclipse Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Vampire |image1 = Vamp.png |mode_appearance = [[Tower Outskirts|Solar Eclipse Night III]]
[[Totality Tower|Solar Eclipse Night IV]] |first_wave_appearance = 8 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]250 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]] Below Average (2.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Bat Transform}}''' - Upon its death, the '''Vampire''' spawns a [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Bat]].}} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Show them no mercy!|audio = Night4Wave8.ogg|[[The Umbra (Narrator)|The Umbra]] dialogue on Wave 8 ([[Totality Tower]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Vampire''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared on the third and fourth night as part of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a high amount of health and a below average speed. Upon death, it would spawn a [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Bat]], which had lower health than it but much faster speed. The [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Bat]] was also a flying enemy, meaning you required towers with flying detection to defeat it. ==Appearance== The '''Vampire''' had purple skin, wore a white tuxedo with a yellow buttoned black shirt, dark brown pants and boots. It had white hair and floated a short distance above the ground while covering its face with its right arm. ==Strategy== *While towers like the [[Minigunner]] or the [[Crook Boss]] can kill this, the [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Bat]] that spawns upon its death is a flying enemy, making most towers useless against it. **You can use the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Hunter]] or the [[Pursuit]] to reliably kill both the '''Vampire''' and the [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Bat]] it spawns. *If a '''Vampire''' has low health and is near the end of the map, try not to kill it, as it will transform into a [[Bat (Solar Eclipse)|Bat]] and do considerably more damage to the base. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Vampire''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Vampire''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Vampire''' added. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in the [[Totality Tower]]. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Vampire''' removed. {{TowerOutskirts|[[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]]|Wave 7|Vampire|Wave 8|[[Wraith]]|Wave 10}} {{TotalityTower|[[Lunar Shard (Legacy)|Lunar Shard]] & [[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]]|Wave 7|Vampire|Wave 8|[[Solar Shard (Legacy)|Solar Shard]]|Wave 9}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Vampire}}
